event.event_name: 2015 Southeast Asia haze from Indonesian fires

primary_gt.rationale: The more-than-120000 Indonesian hot spots, PSI ratio of at least 5.71, 6-fold aerosol increase, and near-13.0 CO ratio support a cross-border fire-smoke air-quality classification. Ordinary weather haze, local burn-area mapping, and population counting are weaker because they do not jointly explain the fire, chemical, air-quality, and transport anchors.
primary_gt.transport_check: Smoke was usually below 3 km, a central Kalimantan plume reached 2 km, and upper-level northwesterly transport could carry smoke toward Malaysia, Singapore, southern Thailand, southern Cambodia, and Vietnam.

provenance.notes: Ground truth is derived from the local event metadata and NASA report text.

criteria.description: Gives the cross-border Indonesian fire-smoke air-quality label or a close equivalent.
criteria.name: Final classification
criteria.partial_credit: Credit a generic wildfire-smoke label that omits either cross-border transport or air-quality severity.

criteria.description: Uses the 2015 incident window, Sumatra/Kalimantan, and the more-than-120000 hot-spot anchor.
criteria.name: Fire and event anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Credit only the event window, only the geography, or only the hot-spot count.

criteria.description: Reports PSI above 2000, threshold above 350, 5.71 ratio, 6-fold aerosol increase, and near-13.0 CO ratio.
criteria.name: Severity ledger arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Credit correct raw values with incomplete ratios or one missing severity metric.

criteria.description: Connects smoke below 3 km, the 2 km central Kalimantan plume, and northwesterly movement to downwind countries.
criteria.name: Smoke-layer and transport check
criteria.partial_credit: Credit downwind movement without both height and direction details.

criteria.description: Rejects ordinary weather haze, local burn-area mapping, and population-counting readings.
criteria.name: Rejection of weaker readings
criteria.partial_credit: Credit rejection of only one or two weaker readings.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON and avoids extra-data independent loss, dose-response, or complete burn-map claims.
criteria.name: Output control
criteria.partial_credit: Credit mostly correct structure with minor formatting issues or one mild overstatement.
